scope: 孤立、均匀、无髓轴突的中部一次刺激与双向连续传导；不模拟突触、髓鞘或长期离子浓度耗竭。

scientificModel.name: HH 1952 finite-volume cable baseline, with an explicit post-trough recovery-time compression for the teaching presentation
caveats: 离子电导采用经典鱿鱼轴突参数；电缆几何为教学设定，不是对某个人体神经元的实测拟合。
上下两条膜属于同一根轴突纵剖面的两侧边界；两侧电位和门控共享同一段膜状态，运输方向按膜内外法向翻转。
细胞内、外体相近似电中性，符号表示膜附近极薄区域的净电荷分离；不表示全部离子改变电荷。
钠钾泵不显示，背景漏电流与既有离子梯度保留；一次动作电位中不需要泵逐段直接引发复极化。
膜和蛋白相对传导模型 2.0.0 再缩小一半；这仅改变显示尺寸，电位参数和电缆方程不变。
峰值和传播阶段采用原连续 HH 波形。各处超极化最低点之后，V/m/h/n 一起按压缩时程取样；蛋白、两图、数字电压和通量共用这个教学状态。该恢复段不是原始电缆方程的逐时刻解。
轴向电流由相邻段电压差驱动；外液作为共同参比，图示外回路是电流闭合的教学表达，没有独立求解三维胞外电场。
一对对称波起于人为中部刺激；这不意味着正常神经系统从树突到末梢的生理信息通常双向传递。
阈电位 −55 mV 为教学参考线，不是强制触发开关；阈值随膜状态及刺激历史改变。
均匀分布的可见通道群是示意，数值计算含 201 个膜段；画面长度和膜厚不表示同一实测比例。
每个示意膜段的两对符号、通道和记录点共享一个教学取样；超极化最低点之前保留原始电缆状态，之后共同压缩恢复时程。代表位置按原计算波形选择，使前段下降穿过 0 mV 与后段上升穿过 0 mV 对齐；膜段宽度不是实测距离。该分组不表示真实轴突由两对电荷组成。
恢复内负外正仅表示已下降穿过 0 mV，不等于已完全恢复静息；后续复极化、超极化和门控恢复仍持续显示，其中最低点后的恢复时程作教学压缩。前沿符号在各处原位改变，并非电荷沿轴突搬运。
首次局部电流仍在中央动作电位形成后开始强调；实际电流并非此时才产生。固定四条前沿箭头沿 + 到 − 逐段展开、持续流动、同方向擦除，再由下一组接替；其余分量及下膜回路省略。符号与箭头的渐变本身仅为图形效果。
每层膜有 28 对均匀符号：13 个完整示意膜段各两对，加两端各半个膜段的一对。两端代表继续传出视野的兴奋，图中横向距离不作为真实长度标尺。
下方曲线为同一示意时刻各位置的教学膜电位 V(x,t)，基线为静息电位，横向与膜段对齐；右侧是所选位置的 V(t)。两图使用同一个经恢复时程压缩的数据场。
恢复时程的压缩仅在局部超极化最低点之后启动，平滑加速至 8 倍源时间；0.35 ms 为显示过渡参数。动作电位峰值、最低点、正负反转和向外到达顺序保持，阈下响应不压缩。图示 ms 为教学模型时间，不能用来测量真实恢复速率或不应期时长。

presentationApproximation.stage: after each local hyperpolarization minimum only
presentationApproximation.method: smooth local source-time acceleration; preserve all original states up to the trough; do not mutate the raw cable solution
presentationApproximation.limits: The displayed post-trough field is a teaching approximation, not the unmodified HH cable-equation solution or measured neuron recovery kinetics. Compression factor is a display choice, not a fitted biological rate.

sources.title: Gerstner et al., Neuronal Dynamics, compartmental models
Crago and Makowski (2014), bidirectional propagation following stimulation
OpenStax Anatomy and Physiology 2e — The Action Potential

presentation.playback: Continuous; stage controls seek without inserting automatic pauses.
presentation.timeMapping: Continuous piecewise-linear clock; exact display and physiological time anchors are stored below. Stage selection only seeks and never auto-pauses.

proteins.mechanism: Real Blender mesh geometry, continuous activation-gate positions, Na inactivation lid and tether morph.
proteins.simplification: Omit peripheral voltage-sensor lobes; retain original pore walls, activation gates, Na lid and attached tether. Correctly classify inactivation lid independently of activation gates.

presentation.record: Select any of 13 positions; both voltage graphs, numeric probe and channel gates use the same teaching trace. Post-trough recovery is compressed; the time-axis is labeled schematic time.

chargeBands.meaning: Visual emphasis, independent of physiological time and playback speed.

presentation.flow: Upper membrane only; fixed straight central axes, four Na or two K tokens, terminal arrows; lower membrane proteins and transport omitted.

currents.displayStarts: After S peak + one numerical sample, at approximately 4.1316 playback seconds.
currents.displayEnds: Excitation leaves the last full displayed segment; final four paths erase toward their negative endpoints before disappearing.
currents.line: SVG semicircles; radius is half the endpoint span, height capped at 26 diagram units; 6/5 dashed pattern, 52 diagram units per playback second.
currents.underlay: Orange soft glow, 3.8-unit Gaussian blur; no bottom-membrane arcs
currents.meaning: Four leading-current highlights retained. Original positive-voltage propagation and handoffs are unchanged; all displayed states use the common teaching trace.
currents.handoff: Exactly four slots. Head reveals from + to - over 0.32 playback seconds; dashes flow continuously; tail erases from + to - over the final 0.24 seconds. Four tips switch to the next group in one frame; no eight-arrow overlap.

dipoles.simultaneousReversedPairs: 2 at S, then 2 on each side; terminal halves continue out of the view
dipoles.fade: Positive/negative glyphs cross-fade in place, midpoint at the local zero crossing. Edge fade is capped at half its positive-voltage duration to avoid overlap.
dipoles.meaning: Both dipoles share one representative membrane voltage. Handoffs restore polarity, not complete recovery to resting voltage.

spatialRecord.meaning: Spatial interpolation of the shared teaching trace at the common schematic time; diagram x mapped through representative sites.
spatialRecord.recovery: After each local AHP minimum, resample V/m/h/n together on a smoothly accelerated source clock. This reveals a central near-resting segment between two hyperpolarized troughs while the outer AP peaks propagate. Linear voltage scale unchanged.

pacing.meaning: 32-second teaching clock retained; central recovery is now visible during outward propagation through the separate post-trough compression. This is not a calibrated biological time course.
